# State Class View (variant): Geospatial and remote sensing analyst (state)

> **Not a classification basis / not a job analysis / not for RIF or rating decisions.**
>
> Task importance, time share, critical and needed-at-entry values are agent drafts (raterType llm, validationStatus draft, evidence S): assessment pending (job analysis). They are not job-analysis results and no human has reviewed them. Target levels are editorial design drafts. A credential gate is shown only when its issuer is verified with a cited source; the other gates are counted, not shown, until the issuer is verified (CR-CP-001 C7).

- **Role:** Geospatial and remote sensing analyst (`emst:core/ROL-1GQVAH3`, P1); authority position (editorial): resource-manager
- **Generated:** pipelines/views/state_class_view.py@0.3.0, rule state-class-view@0.2.0 (registered rule, status active), as of 2026-10-23

## Mapped classes

No class is mapped at skos:closeMatch or stronger in the pilot jurisdictions (TX, WA and PA (state), Lewis County WA (county environmental health), Philadelphia Water Department (municipal utility)). The role's targets below are what a jurisdiction would crosswalk its own class specification against.

## Competency targets by role level (editorial draft target levels, agent-drafted)

- Analyze remotely sensed data to map and monitor environmental conditions — journey L2, senior L3, lead L4
- Conduct spatial analysis and modelling of environmental data — journey L2, senior L3, lead L4
- Design maps and visualizations that communicate environmental data and uncertainty — journey L2, senior L3, lead L3
- Build and validate automated detection and classification models for environmental observations — journey L2, senior L3, lead L4
- Evaluate model fitness-for-purpose and validate against independent evidence — journey L2, senior L3, lead L4
- Conduct reproducible, auditable environmental analysis, including AI-assisted code — journey L2, senior L3, lead L3
- Quantify and communicate uncertainty for environmental decisions — journey L2, senior L3, lead L3
- Ground-truth remote-sensed, modelled and AI-generated outputs in the field — journey L1, senior L2, lead L3
- Protect sensitive ecological, cultural and personal information in data products — journey L2, senior L2, lead L3
- Validate AI-generated work products before professional use — journey L2, senior L3, lead L3
- Steward and publish environmental data for reuse — journey L2, senior L2, lead L3
- Design and steward field reference data for Earth-observation and AI models — senior L2, lead L3
- Design decision-support products for actual decision contexts — lead L3
- Design and manage environmental databases — journey L2, senior L2, lead L3
- Operate and supervise uncrewed and automated field systems — journey L1, senior L1, lead L1
- Interpret and question environmental data products in everyday work — journey L1, senior L1, lead L1
- Use AI tools responsibly in everyday environmental work — journey L1, senior L1, lead L1
- Record provenance and AI involvement in work products — journey L1, senior L1, lead L1
- Supervise staff and volunteers in environmental work — senior L3, lead L4
